content.title: ‘The Masked Singer’ finale will be interrupted by Trump’s primetime address: What to know
content.text: Published April 1, 2026 10:29am PDT WASHINGTON - President Donald Trump’s primetime address on Wednesday is expected to interrupt several shows. How to watch ‘The Masked Singer finale’ What you can do: "The Masked Singer" is slated to run from 8 to 10 p.m. ET but will pause for Trump's address and then resume. President Trump’s address will begin at 9:00 p.m. ET (6:00 p.m. PT) and is expected to last approximately 20 minutes. Trump’s remarks are expected to cut into several major TV shows, including the season finale of "The Masked Singer." (Credit: Michael Becker/FOX) This means that the episode will pick up where they left off around 9:20 p.m. ET, and run until about 10:24 p.m. ET, airing in its entirety, the networks confirmed. The Masked Singer Season 14 finale Dig deeper: During Wednesday’s finale, the show will feature four unmaskings – but only one can win it all. RELATED: ‘The Masked Singer’ reveals Pangolin; here’s who it is The four finalists competing for the Golden Mask Trophy include: Cat Witch, Galaxy Girl, Crane and Pugcasso. Trump’s primetime address The backstory: Trump, 79, will address the nation at 9 p.m. ET on Wednesday, April 1, to "provide an important update on Iran," according to a post from White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt. "TUNE IN: Tomorrow night at 9PM ET, President Trump will give an Address to the Nation to provide an important update on Iran," Leavitt said on social media platform X.
